Rooms & Suites at Castillo Inn – Beachside Hotel in Santa Barbara

Superior Two Queens
Definitely “a cut above the rest” this room has two Queen beds and includes high thread count linens, refrigerator, gourmet in-room coffee, Sony 32 inch TV and an additional 19 inch TV for additional viewing (free HBO, DVD player, desk and free wireless Internet, seating area with a comfortable sleeper sofa, iron and full size ironing board.

Patio Room
Enjoy indoor comfort with the added pleasure of private outdoor space. Our Patio Rooms feature a King or Two Queen beds dressed in premium linens, along with a comfortable seating area and sleeper sofa for added flexibility.
Step outside onto your private patio to relax in the coastal sunshine or unwind after a day exploring Santa Barbara’s waterfront. Thoughtfully designed for comfort and relaxation, this room is ideal for guests who appreciate extra space and fresh ocean air.

Deluxe Room
Our Deluxe Rooms offer added space and comfort, ideal for couples or small families. Available with One Queen, One King, or Two Queen beds, each room includes a cozy seating area with a sofa bed, making it easy to relax after a day at the beach or downtown Santa Barbara.
A comfortable balance of style and practicality, the Deluxe Room is perfect for longer stays or guests seeking extra room to unwind.

Standard Room
Comfortable, inviting, and thoughtfully appointed, our Standard Rooms provide everything needed for a relaxing Santa Barbara stay. Available with a Queen, King, or Two Queen beds, these rooms feature premium linens and modern essentials in a clean, coastal-inspired setting.
Ideal for travelers who plan to spend their days exploring the beach and local attractions, the Standard Room offers exceptional comfort and value. No seating area or sofabed in this room.

Accessible Room
Our Accessible Room offers the same comfort and amenities as our Queen Room, thoughtfully designed for ease of access and mobility.
Features include accessible routes from parking and registration areas, a roll-under sink, adjustable shower head, grab bars in the bathroom, and a wider bathroom entry. Designed to provide both comfort and convenience

Castillo Suite
Experience the comfort of a beachside retreat in our spacious Castillo Suite. Featuring Mediterranean-inspired décor, the suite includes a private master bedroom with a King bed, a second bedroom with a Queen bed, and a separate living room area with a sofabed.
The fully equipped kitchen allows for extended stays or family gatherings, while elegant finishes and generous space create a relaxed, residential feel just steps from the beach.

Located on the upper floor, our Specialty Room offers added space, and an elevated sense of comfort. Available with a King bed, these spacious accommodations include a seating area with a sleeper sofa, making them ideal for families or guests seeking a more open and airy environment.
A perfect choice for those wanting extra room to relax while enjoying the charm of Santa Barbara.

What time is check-in and check-out?
Check in time 3pm-9pm, call the hotel 24 hours in advance to check in after 9pm.
Check out 8am-11am
Do you offer breakfast?
While we do not offer breakfast, guests are welcome to visit our lobby marketplace, open daily from 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM, featuring a selection of  drinks and snacks for purchase.
Do rooms have accessibility access?
We have a limited number of designated accessibility guestrooms.
Are pets allowed?
We welcome service animals.
Is parking included ?
Complimentary parking is available for our guests. Limited to one (1) vehicle per room reserved, no trailers and oversized vans/trucks. If needed, Public parking is available nearby for additional vehicles (fees vary).
What is cancellation fee?
1st night room rate if cancelled within 48 hours of your arrival date
Is cash payment accepted?
We only accept debit or credit cards.

About Castillo Inn – Beachside Hotel in Santa Barbara, CA​
Skip to content
The Castillo Inn is a charming 20 room and 1 apartment/suite boutique inn of distinctive Mediterranean architecture. You ll find yourself just a short stroll from Stearn s Wharf and the Marina breakwater, where you can visit the Santa Barbara Maritime Museum or dine at one of the many waterfront restaurants.
The Inn is also only a short walk or trolley ride to Santa Barbara s world renowned State Street, and to the Amtrak station . On State Street, you can enjoy the marvelous Mediterranean architecture & atmosphere as you shop, sightsee and dine.
Use the Castillo Inn as your headquarters during your stay in Santa Barbara. Whether you re here to sightsee, enjoy the multitude of special events and outdoor activities, or do some shopping and dining. You ll find the Castillo Inn the perfect place to stay.

Hotel Policies | Castillo Inn Santa Barbara
Skip to content
Policies
Check-in Requirements:
Government-issued photo identification is required. Room and tax payment is required upon check-in.
Your Credit card will be authorized at 12 PM ~ 48 hours prior to arrival for $100 to validate your credit card. This will also be included as a deposit for incidentals.  It is refundable after checkout. If the authorization is unsuccessful, we will attempt to reach you to replace  with a  new valid credit card. You will have until 9pm day of call or email to contact us and provide new credit card details.
Cards Accepted:
Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, JCB, China Union Pay
Check-in / Check-out Time:
Check in time 3pm-9pm, call the hotel 24 hours in advance to check in after 9pm.
Check out 8am-11am. All reservation checkout date modifications must be made before the checkout time
Cancellation:
If canceled 48 hours before the arrival date, no fee will be charged. If cancelled after this time, or in case of no show, 100% of first 1 night’s room and tax will be charged
No Show:
If guest does not arrive by Midnight 12am, 100% of first 1 night’s room and tax will be charged
Pets :
We are not a pet-friendly hotel. We do comply with ADA service animals.
Vehicle Registration:
Complimentary parking is available for our guests. Limited to one (1) vehicle per room reserved.
If needed, Public parking is available nearby for additional vehicles (fees vary). . No over-sized trucks, trailers, or recreational vehicles are permitted
No Smoking:
Hotel public areas and all guestrooms are non-smoking. A $250 fee will apply if policy violated. In case of smoking and/or noise complaints, hotel reserves the right to proceed with an early check out without refund in addition to incidental charges.
Money and any other valuable items brought to Castillo Inn is at guest’s sole risk. Castillo Inn and staff accept no liability and shall not be responsible for any loss or damage items therefore guests remain solely responsible for their belongings
